title: Backend Engineer - Python
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain production backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Build reliable REST APIs supporting AI-powered application workflows.
Design and maintain SQL or NoSQL database schemas based on application requirements.
Develop clean, testable, and maintainable backend code.
Implement integrations with internal services, external APIs, and AI/LLM systems.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to backend architecture decisions.
Debug production issues and improve application reliability and performance.
Collaborate with frontend, AI, product, and infrastructure teams.
description: We are looking for a Backend Engineer with professional Python development experience to build production services supporting AI-powered applications. The engineer will work extensively with Python, FastAPI, databases, APIs, and distributed application components. Experience with AI agents, LLM integrations, vector databases, or cloud infrastructure is valuable but not mandatory.
